Interval Forest with Unit Values

Source: R/figure-plots-forest.R
PlotIntervalForest.Rd

One row per analysis or cell type: an interval (for example a bootstrap confidence interval of the median), a marked estimate, optional jittered unit (patient) values behind it, a reference line and a statistic text to the right of the panel written from the data. Units flagged in the unit table (for example patients with low support) can be drawn as open symbols in their group colour with a short label.

Usage

PlotIntervalForest(
  data,
  points = NULL,
  row = "row",
  estimate = "estimate",
  lower = "lower",
  upper = "upper",
  value = "value",
  row_order = NULL,
  row_labels = NULL,
  colours = "ink",
  interval_colours = NULL,
  estimate_size = 18,
  estimate_edge = 0.4,
  interval_linewidth = 1.2,
  point_colour = "#BDBDBD",
  point_size = 5,
  jitter = 0.18,
  seed = 1,
  flag = NULL,
  flag_group = NULL,
  group_colours = NULL,
  flag_size = 15,
  flag_edge = 0.8,
  flag_label = NULL,
  flag_label_size = 4.8,
  flag_label_vjust = 0.5,
  flag_spread = 0.17,
  label = NULL,
  label_size = 4.8,
  label_colour = "muted",
  label_x = 1.03,
  reference_x = 0,
  reference_linewidth = 0.6,
  x_limits = NULL,
  y_limits = NULL,
  x_breaks = NULL,
  x_nbins = 6,
  x_label = NULL,
  y_label = NULL,
  tick_size_x = NULL,
  tick_size_y = NULL,
  title_size = NULL,
  grid = c("x", "none"),
  box_mm = NULL,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

Summary table, one row per row of the forest.

points

Optional unit table with row and value columns.

row, estimate, lower, upper

Columns of data.

value

Value column of points.

row_order

Rows from top to bottom (default: order in data).

row_labels

Named tick labels per row.

colours

Estimate colours: one colour or named per row.

interval_colours

Interval colours (default: the estimate colours).

estimate_size

Estimate marker area (pt^2), drawn with a white edge of estimate_edge points.

estimate_edge

Edge width.

interval_linewidth

Interval width in points.

point_colour, point_size

Unit points (area in pt^2).

jitter

Half-width of the vertical jitter of unit points (rows are one unit apart).

seed

Seed of the jitter (presentation only).

flag

Optional logical column of points marking units drawn as open symbols in their group colour instead of grey points; these are spread over flag_spread around the row in their order of appearance.

flag_group

Group column of points for flagged units.

group_colours

Named group colours.

flag_size, flag_edge

Open symbol area and edge width.

flag_label

Optional column of points written left of flagged symbols.

flag_label_size, flag_label_vjust

Its size and vertical justification.

flag_spread

Half-range of the vertical spread of flagged symbols.

label

Optional template (see FormatTemplate()) written for each row at label_x (panel fraction) to the right.

label_size, label_colour, label_x

Label style and position.

reference_x

Position of the vertical reference line (NULL for none).

reference_linewidth

Its width in points.

x_limits, y_limits

Limits; rows sit at 1 (bottom) to n (top). Automatic limits add 5% of the data range.

x_breaks, x_nbins

x ticks.

x_label, y_label

Axis titles.

tick_size_x, tick_size_y

Tick label sizes.

title_size

Axis title size.

grid

"x" (default) or "none".

box_mm

Size of the data area c(width, height) in millimetres, passed by RenderFigure(); used by "auto" tick intervals (see NiceBreaks()).

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'ggplot2' object.

Examples

s <- data.frame(row = c("a", "b"), estimate = c(1, -0.5), lower = c(0.2, -1.2),
                upper = c(1.5, 0.1), k = c(9, 7), n = 9, p = c(0.004, 0.1))
pts <- data.frame(row = rep(c("a", "b"), each = 5), value = c(rnorm(5, 1), rnorm(5, -0.5)))
PlotIntervalForest(s, pts, colours = c(a = "#D9730D", b = "#C2378E"),
                   label = "{k|d}/{n|d} patients; p = {p|p}")
